summaries.title: DataFlex: A Unified Framework for Data-Centric Dynamic Training of Large Language Models

summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（For data mixture, DoReMi and ODM improve both MMLU accuracy and corpus-level perplexity over default proportions...；These results demonstrate that DataFlex provides an effective, efficient, and reproducible infrastructure for...）。
